prompt.initial:
Redesign the first reference image into ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail. The first image is ONLY the approved visual style template; replace ALL its player, date, name, scores and text. The second reference is the OFFICIAL appearance reference for the one real player to illustrate, Rikiya Yamaguchi / 山口力也 of Yamaguchi Patsfive. Do not paste any photograph or reproduce logos. This is an expressive hand-drawn editorial sports illustration, not photorealistic.

Canvas: landscape approximately 16:9, preferably 1600x900 or 1536x864, at least 1000 pixels wide. Dark charcoal green-black #151A18 background, bright lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush strokes, warm off-white heavy Japanese typography, sparse ink flecks, very few elements. Match the striking handmade black-and-lime visual language of the approved template.

Composition: completely change the template's upright shooting pose to a dynamic low driving dribble. Left 51% is strong readable editorial type with clean negative space. Right 49% contains only ONE recognizable real player, Rikiya Yamaguchi, shown from head to thighs in a forward leaning basketball drive with bent knees, torso turned three-quarter toward the viewer, face turned sufficiently forward to retain recognizability. His right hand controls an orange basketball in the lower-right, with one anatomically correct hand resting on the upper side of the ball. His other arm is bent protectively and its natural five-finger hand is visible around waist height. Keep head, elbows, hands and ball inside the frame, away from every text line. Player does not cover the left text. Exaggerate movement through one sweeping lime brush arc and clothing folds, not additional people or duplicate limbs. Use clearly drawn black ink contours, cream highlights and flat brush shadows on the body, with orange accents on a plain sleeveless uniform. Entire uniform must be unbranded with no numbers, names, club/league logos or sponsor marks. Ball is only his handheld/dribbling prop.

Likeness: faithfully use the second reference's actual Rikiya Yamaguchi facial features: slim athletic Japanese adult, long narrow face and narrow jaw/chin, visible ears, medium tousled wavy brown hair with dark roots and lighter brown streaks, a shaggy asymmetrical fringe over the upper forehead, relatively narrow dark eyes and mostly straight brows, straight long nose, thin sparse mustache above upper lip, small pointed dark goatee below lower lip and on chin, cheeks clean rather than full beard, long slender neck. Face needs enough detail and light to compare to the official reference, without becoming a photograph. Do NOT retain the first image's Black player, curly short haircut, pose, or facial features.

Render EXACTLY the following Japanese copy, preserving spelling, digits and punctuation, with no other words or numbers:
Top-left small brand: 「バスケまとめ」
Largest lime date line: 「11/01」
Largest bold off-white headline below date: 「試合結果」
Medium bold off-white subheadline: 「当日のEFF」
Clearly readable qualifier, on a compact lime or off-white strip below the subheadline: 「一部公式記録は確定待ち」
Smaller but readable source snapshot line: 「19:26時点の掲載情報」
Bottom-left footer on clear solid dark ground, kept well inside safe margins: 「イラスト（AI生成）　イメージ」

Keep 4% safe margins around all lettering. Strong thumbnail readability. The visual represents a general imagined basketball action, NOT an actual verified match scene, highlight or winning shot. The depicted player was randomly selected from names in the fixed article, so DO NOT put his name, statistics, participation, achievements or team name in the image. No scores, no rankings, no jersey number. Do not copy any old text, date, 38-point claim or score from the first reference. The fixed article is an 11/01 game-results/EFF roundup with some official results pending; the image must not imply all games or rankings are final. Make one polished final thumbnail only.

The ball is touching the bottom edge and the hair nearly touches the top edge. Uniformly scale the entire right-hand PLAYER-AND-BALL illustration group to about 91% of its current size around its own center, preserving all anatomy and the same driving-dribble gesture. Position it so the complete hair silhouette, both hands, elbows, and especially the entire circular basketball outline have at least 35-45 pixels of dark/background breathing room from the outer canvas edges. The basketball must be fully visible, with a visible background gap below it and to its right. The thighs may remain naturally cropped at the bottom. Keep the full left text panel unchanged and perfectly readable. Maintain the same landscape approximately 16:9 resolution at least 1000 px wide, charcoal black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brush illustration, plain orange uniform, no logos, no names/numbers, no photographic elements.
